missions.route: Salt Freeholder trade run — Settlement 2 (the Freeholder's territory)
missions.weather: clear, cold, -3C to +1C (the second winter, warming)
missions.objective: Trade 10kg of winter rye flour and 5kg of dried clover for 8kg of salt, 3kg of smoked fish, and intelligence on the hollow.

cargo_outbound.notes: Ground from zone 1 winter rye harvest. The rye is the thing that is the harvest. The harvest is the thing that is the family.
Harvested from zone 3. The clover is the thing that is the nitrogen. The nitrogen is the thing that is the soil.

cargo_inbound.notes: Solar-evaporated from the Salt Flats. The salt is the thing that is the trade. The trade is the thing that is the bridge.
Caught in the unfrozen lakes. The fish is the thing that is the protein. The protein is the thing that is the strength.

missions.summary:
Departed at dawn. the_courier led. the_hunter navigated. the_naive_son carried the flour. the_naive_son did not speak. He carried. The carrying is the thing the Naive Son does when the past is too heavy. The past is heavy. The carrying is the thing that puts the flour on the sled. The sled is the thing that is the trade.

Reached Settlement 2 at hour 10. the_Freeholder met us at the perimeter. She said, 'The rye is the thing that is the winter. The clover is the thing that is the spring. The winter and the spring are the things that are the trade.' She weighed the flour and the clover. She said, 'The trade is fair. The trade is the thing that is the bridge.' She gave us 8kg of salt and 3kg of smoked fish. She said, 'The salt is the thing that is the preservation. The preservation is the thing that is the living.'

We asked about the hollow. She said, 'The hollow is the place where the snowflake falls. The snowflake is the thing that is the fourth carving. The fourth carving is the thing that is the bridge. The bridge is the thing that is the next family.' She said, 'The next family is the thing that is not the 47. The 47 are the thing that is the family. The next family is the thing that is the living.' She said, 'The hollow is the place where the bridge begins. The bridge is the thing that connects the family to the next family.' She said, 'The Cartographer is the thing that walks the hollow. The Cartographer is the thing that watches the wolves. The wolves are the thing that is not the family. The family is the thing that is the 47.'

We asked if she had seen the next family. She said, 'The next family is the thing that is not the 47. The 47 are the thing that is the family. The next family is the thing that is the living. The living is the thing that is not the winter. The winter is the thing that is the wolf. The wolf is the thing that is the first carving. The first carving is the thing that is the past. The past is the thing that is not the living. The living is the thing that is the next family.' She said, 'The next family is the thing that is the bridge. The bridge is the thing that is the hollow. The hollow is the place where the snowflake falls.'

We departed at hour 12. the_naive_son carried the salt. He did not speak. He carried. The carrying is the thing the Naive Son does. The carrying is the thing that is the present. The present is the thing the Naive Son is in.

Returned at dusk. the_quartermaster logged the salt and the fish. the_council convened to discuss the hollow. the_courier said, 'The Freeholder speaks in the 16 words. The 16 words are the thing the family lives by. The 16 words are the thing the next family may live by.' the_council said, 'The 16 words are the thing the family is. The family is the 16 words.'
intelligence_gathered: The hollow is the place where the snowflake falls. The snowflake is the fourth carving.
The Cartographer walks the hollow. The Cartographer watches the wolves.
The next family is the thing that is not the 47. The 47 are the thing that is the family.
The bridge is the thing that connects the family to the next family. The bridge is the thing that is the hollow.
The Freeholder speaks in the 16 words. The 16 words are: source, reserve, shelf, growing, farm, herb, trade, community, bees, medicine, pollination, bridge, clover, hollow, snowflake, living.
recommendations: the_council to discuss the hollow. The hollow is the place where the bridge begins.
the_family to walk the 4 zones. The 4 zones are the thing the family farms. The family is the 4 zones.

the_naive_son to continue carrying. The carrying is the thing that is the present. The present is the thing the Naive Son is in.
the_hunter to monitor the route to Settlement 2. The route is the thing that is the trade. The trade is the thing that is the bridge.
